text: dsh-provider-auto 为 DSH Web 的兼容 provider 补充推理等级：监听 llm-pi-ai 设置，按协议和模型名识别 gpt-5、o<number>、codex 等文本模型，为缺少声明的模型添加 off、low、medium、high 选项。它跳过图像、音频等非文本模型，保留已有设置，并允许配置匹配规则和等级映射。适合使用自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关、希望模型选择器显示推理等级的用户。安装后需重启一次 dsh web，无需额外密钥或账号。

dsh-provider-auto adds missing reasoning levels to compatible text models in DSH Web. It watches llm-pi-ai settings, preserves existing values, and skips non-text models. Matching rules and effort mappings are configurable for custom OpenAI-compatible gateways.
让自定义 OpenAI 兼容模型也能显示推理等级选项。
我的网关模型没有能力元数据，能自动补上 reasoningEfforts 吗？
我想按模型名称为兼容 provider 配置 off、low、medium、high 档位。
DSH 的模型选择器为什么没显示推理强度？
Add reasoning effort choices to custom OpenAI-compatible models in DSH.
Can missing reasoning capability metadata be inferred from my model IDs?
dsh-provider-auto 的功能「补充推理等级」：监听 llm-pi-ai 设置，检查允许的 provider 协议和模型名称，为匹配且没有 reasoningEfforts 的模型添加默认等级映射。设置变化时自动再次同步。
dsh-provider-auto 的功能「排除不适用模型」：自动跳过图像、音频、embedding、moderation 和 rerank 名称匹配的模型，也不覆盖已经存在 reasoningEfforts 字段的模型。
dsh-provider-auto 的功能「自定义匹配和等级映射」：通过插件配置指定处理的 API 协议、模型匹配与排除规则，以及每个推理等级对应的 provider 值。
给不同网关的推理档位映射成各自接受的参数值。
Preserve manual reasoning settings while filling in missing model capabilities.

dsh-provider-auto README · dsh-provider-auto：Automatically adds reasoning-effort controls to compatible custom provider models in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-provider-auto README · What it does：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` only shows a reasoning selector when a model declares `reasoningEfforts`. Custom OpenAI-compatible gateways often return model ids but no capability metadata. This plugin watches the `llm-pi-ai` settings section and fills the missing declaration for recognized reasoning models.

Defaults:

dsh-provider-auto README · What it does：- Protocols: `openai-completions`, `openai-responses`
- Models: `gpt-5*`, `o1*`, `o3*`, `o4*`, other `o<number>*`, and `codex*`
- Levels: `off`, `low`, `medium`, `high`
- Exclusions: image, audio, embedding, moderation, and reranking models
- Existing `reasoningEfforts` declarations are never overwritten

The plugin updates the persisted `llm-pi-ai` section, so DSH's native model picker and request path remain authoritative.

dsh-provider-auto README · Install：Install directly from GitHub into the Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:icekale/dsh-provider-auto
```

Restart `dsh web` once after installation. Later provider/model changes are handled live through the settings service.

To remove it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-provider-auto
```

dsh-provider-auto README · Provider configuration：Add providers from the DSH Models page, or edit `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    one2api:
      baseURL: https://one2api.top/v1

The plugin adds this only to `gpt-5.6-sol`:

```yaml
reasoningEfforts:
  off: null
  low: low
  medium: medium

dsh-provider-auto README · Plugin configuration：Override the plugin row in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` when a gateway uses different model names or wire values:

```yaml
- id: provider-auto
  config:
    api:
      - openai-completions

A provider that uses different wire values can map them explicitly:

```yaml
- id: provider-auto
  config:
    efforts:
      off: null

dsh-provider-auto README · Limits：This plugin does not implement provider protocols or authentication. DSH still supports only protocols available through its installed adapters. Model capability discovery is name-based because OpenAI-compatible `/models` endpoints generally do not report reasoning levels. For an exceptional model, declare `reasoningEfforts` manually; the plugin preserves it.

dsh-provider-auto README · Development：```sh
npm test
```

Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

dsh-provider-auto README · dsh-provider-auto：为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 中兼容的自定义 provider 模型自动补充推理强度选项。

[English](README.md)

dsh-provider-auto README · 功能：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 只有在模型声明 `reasoningEfforts` 时才显示推理强度。多数 OpenAI 兼容网关的 `/models` 接口只返回模型 ID，不返回推理能力。该插件监听 `llm-pi-ai` 设置，为识别到的推理模型补充缺失的能力声明。

默认规则：

- 协议：`openai-completions`、`openai-responses`
- 模型：`gpt-5*`、`o1*`、`o3*`、`o4*`、其他 `o<数字>*`、`codex*`
- 等级：`off`、`low`、`medium`、`high`
- 排除图片、音频、embedding、moderation、rerank 模型
- 不覆盖已有的 `reasoningEfforts`

插件写回 DSH 原生 `llm-pi-ai` 设置，因此模型选择器和请求发送仍由 DSH 原生实现负责。

dsh-provider-auto README · 安装：从 GitHub 安装到 Web profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:icekale/dsh-provider-auto
```

安装后重启一次 `dsh web`。之后通过模型页面新增 provider 或模型时会实时处理。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-provider-auto
```

dsh-provider-auto README · Provider 配置：可以通过 DSH 的模型页面添加，也可以编辑 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    one2api:
      baseURL: https://one2api.top/v1

插件只会给 `gpt-5.6-sol` 补充：

```yaml
reasoningEfforts:
  off: null
  low: low
  medium: medium

dsh-provider-auto README · 插件配置：当网关使用不同模型命名或参数值时，在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖插件配置：

```yaml
- id: provider-auto
  config:
    api:
      - openai-completions

如果 provider 接受不同的 wire value，可以显式映射：

```yaml
- id: provider-auto
  config:
    efforts:
      off: null
dsh-provider-auto README · 限制：该插件不实现新的 provider 协议或认证方式，DSH 仍只能调用已安装适配器支持的协议。由于 OpenAI 兼容 `/models` 通常不返回推理等级，自动识别只能依据模型名称。特殊模型可以手动声明 `reasoningEfforts`，插件不会覆盖。

dsh-provider-auto README · 开发：```sh
npm test
```

要求 Node.js 22 或更高版本。
